seo.description: Shop mommy and me swimsuits for moms and daughters featuring one shoulder. Perfect for beach days, pool parties, and vacations. Shop now at Dress Like Mommy. Free shipping + 30-day returns.

before.descriptionHtml:
• Embrace summer vibes with our one-shoulder ruffle swimsuit, designed for both women and girls to enjoy a matching beach look.
  • Crafted from a premium blend of nylon and polyester fiber, this swim set offers both comfort and durability, making it a perfect companion for all water-related activities.
  • The vibrant tropical print set against a classic black base presents a striking contrast that's sure to turn heads at the pool or beach.
  • Features a flattering asymmetrical cut with a playful ruffle trim that adds a touch of whimsy to your swimwear ensemble.
  • Easy to maintain and quick to dry, the fabric's resilience ensures long-lasting color vibrancy and shape retention after multiple washes.

Description: Dive into the sunny season with our Chic Floral Ruffle One-Shoulder Swimsuit for women and girls. Inspired by the lush beauty of tropical paradises, this swimwear set captures the essence of summer fun with its eye-catching print and feminine ruffle detailing. The asymmetrical design not only stands out in style but also provides a flattering silhouette for all body types. Made from a soft and stretchy blend of nylon and polyester fiber, this duo promises to keep you and your little one comfortable, whether you're splashing in the waves or building sandcastles on the shore. Its durable material is resistant to chlorine and saltwater, ensuring that you can enjoy this stunning swimsuit for seasons to come. Perfect for family vacations, pool parties, or simply enjoying the great outdoors, this swimsuit set is a must-have for any fashion-forward duo.
